name: WarpZone
description: Runs your own dumped Super Mario Bros. ROM inside Geometry Dash using a built-in NES emulator. No ROM is included; you must supply a .nes file.

skip-crc-check.name: Skip ROM checksum
skip-crc-check.description: Accept any NROM-256 ROM even if its CRC32 doesn't match the known SMB1 dump. Only needed if your valid dump is rejected.
